name: ultrasolve
description: Rigorous methods for solving the hardest problems.

interface.shortDescription: Define the real problem, then escape it with rigorous lenses.
interface.longDescription: Ultrasolve states the unstated problem behind a request, then routes well-defined, genuinely stuck problems through six rigorous transformation lenses, then maps the result back to the original constraints and success criteria.
defaultPrompt: Unblock a genuinely stuck problem with the Ultrasolve router.
Invert this problem, then forward-check the result against the original constraints.
Decompose this problem into answerable seams and recompose the result.
